_about: Live barks (docs/ep/cloud-briefs/narrative-live-barks.md): the lines a fighter says in a match, at the beats the sim already emits as fx events. PRESENTATION ONLY: the emitter (NarrativeBarks, parked in docs/narrative/pending/live-barks/) reads the sim's events and never writes the sim, with its own seeded stream, so the golden is untouched. OFF BY DEFAULT: `enabled` is false. EVERY LINE here is an approved line: Orb's own words from homework 1, Orb's marks on homework 11 (the 4 kept lines and the 26 rewrites that came from Gemini at Orb's direction, recorded under ai01), or Orb's approved mid-combat master of 2026-10-30 (322 lines under 16 beats: 242 Gemini rewrites that Orb reviewed and 80 Claude drafts Orb kept; docs/narrative/voice-lab/mid-combat-lines.md). No line is invented for this file. Beats with no approved line are under `unmapped`. Lines under excluded_lines wait on a swap or an event. All 16 beats are read by the emitter (the last five since 2026-10-30).

limits._about: A fighter talks at most once every per_fighter_gap_s and at most max_per_fighter_per_minute a minute; any two barks are global_gap_s apart; no line repeats inside line_cooldown_s (a match is under 10 minutes, so a line plays once until the others are used); the same beat is held off for beat_cooldown_s. Silence is a feature (line-system.md).

display._about_2026_10_30: max_dur_s 2.6 to 4.4 and per_char_s 0.035 to 0.05: the approved lines run to 15 words (about 90 characters), which needs about 4 seconds to read.

lint_note: Each line carries its line-lint result (hard: rules it fails; check: items for a human). `python docs/narrative/line-lint.py --live data/narrative/live_barks.json` lints the file: lines whose source is Orb's own words (line-lint.json orb_own_exemption, EP ruling 2026-10-28) are exempt from R1 and R8 and do not count in the ellipsis rate; every other line is strict. Orb's marks on lines others wrote (hw11) are not exempt. The emitter ignores this field. Since 2026-10-30 the lint's R1 is 4 to 15 words (Orb); eight Orb-approved lines that break a rule are waived by line id in line-lint.json (orb_approved_waivers) and carry `_waived` here; the lint also fails a rotation keyword (ribs, shoulder, rhythm, calories) in two back-to-back beats of one fighter.
